title: Wolfpack public control API and event stream schema

breakingChanges: removing or renaming stable operations, fields, or message types
tightening enum/pattern constraints for stable fields

trustBoundaries: schemas publish public client contracts; they do not replace route-side project/session/path validation
filesystem containment remains in src/server/validate-project-dir.ts and src/validation.ts
broker wire compatibility remains covered by broker codec/protocol tests, not by this schema
peer Ralph aggregation still sanitizes remote loop entries before exposing them to clients
session-open follows ordinary global JWT policy when configured and adds no inter-session authorization layer
named-view machineUrl is a stored HTTPS tailnet origin only; clients must resolve members by (machineUrl, sessionId), never by display name

binaryFrames.client-to-server: raw PTY input bytes, capped by runtime MAX_PTY_BINARY_BYTES

SessionSelector.description: Active session name or stable opaque session identifier

NamedViewName.description: Trimmed display name; 1..64 Unicode code points at runtime

NamedViewSessionId.description: Stable opaque local or peer session identifier

NamedViewSessionName.description: Last-known display hint only; never sufficient for matching

NamedViewMachineUrl.description: Empty string for local machine or HTTPS tailnet origin for a peer
